summary: Wanderer, a four-voice event-memory synthesizer designed for low-vision use: you protect a played idea as an Anchor, evolve a working copy, add a layer and reshape it. It uses large high-contrast symbols and optional sound cues.
features: Anchor keeps an idea; Melt and Drift evolve a working copy
Second layer, and Scatter with eight modes from slices to tape and cloud
100 sounds; subtractive and phase distortion engine with sub bass
Arpeggiator with 13 patterns, latch, swing and USB or TRS clock in
Adaptive zoom, display hold and audio cues for low vision
Printed audio is RAM-only; external clock drives only the arpeggiator
